description: 276 schoolgirls were taken from Government Girls Secondary School in Chibok, Borno State. 82 escaped on their own, 103 were released in small groups between 2016 and 2017 in exchange for prisoners, and at least 91 remain in captivity or their fate is unknown.
time_note: Twelve years, for those not returned.

description: Amnesty has documented at least 17 mass school abductions since 2014 involving more than 1,700 children; ICIR counted 26 major school attacks between April 2014 and May 2026 with at least 2,416 students abducted. In November 2025 some 400 people were kidnapped including more than 300 schoolchildren in two assaults, prompting a UN warning of a surge in mass abductions.

aspect: EXAMPLE - a billion naira for 287 children
description: ANSARU militants abducted 287 students and staff from a Kaduna State school and demanded 1 billion naira, around US$600,000.

aspect: EXAMPLE - the camps are targets too
description: In 2024 Boko Haram abducted over 400 people, mainly women and schoolchildren, from an internally displaced people's camp in Borno State - taking people who had already fled once.
energy_note: Displaced to safety, and taken from there.

aspect: The protection scheme did not arrive
description: Nigeria endorsed the Safe Schools Declaration after Chibok. HRW reported the initiative faced problems and declining momentum with little or no progress in fortifying schools; in 2021 the then-Senate president said after an investigation into fund use that it was designed to fail without a national policy and strategy.
energy_note: A declaration signed, and the schools unchanged.

description: Where a household reduces risk by removing a child from school, the daughter goes before the son - which converts an act of violence into a permanent educational gap that appears in the statistics decades later.
energy_note: Pulled out for her safety, and the cost is the rest of her life.
notes: Feeds directly into EDU-002 and WRK-002.

description: The good secondary school is boarding, four hours away, and in a state that was in the news in March. The day school nearby is weaker and she will pass fewer subjects. Her parents choose the day school and never discuss it again.
energy_note: A worse education, chosen deliberately, for a good reason.
